nodes.name: Daily Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Daily 17:15 UTC — after the ECB publishes (~16:00 CET). Pinned fictional rates and deals for sandbox runs.

nodes.name: Build Run Context
nodes.notes: Config, base currency, safety switches. Fails closed on a missing base currency.

nodes.name: Fetch ECB Reference Rates
nodes.notes: Free, no key · EUR-based reference rates of the last ~90 working days (newest = spot).

nodes.name: Fetch Open Exchange Rates
nodes.notes: App ID in the Authorization header (kept out of URLs and logs) · USD-based on the free plan.

nodes.name: Normalize, Validate & Cache Rates
nodes.notes: Source per currency · stale / jump / cross-source guards · static-data cache.

nodes.name: Search Open International Deals
nodes.notes: Open + recently closed-won deals · 200/page · keyset paging past 10,000.

nodes.name: Convert Deal Amounts
nodes.notes: Exact decimal math · spot or close-date basis · skips with reasons · unchanged = no write.

nodes.name: HubSpot Batch Update Deals
nodes.notes: ≤100 deals per call · one call every 400 ms · 429/5xx retried 3×.

nodes.name: Sanitized Audit Log
nodes.notes: Deal IDs, currencies, rates, before → after · no names, no tokens.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow.

parameters.content:
## n8n-multi-currency-exchange-rate-hubspot-sync
ECB / Open Exchange Rates → validated rate table → HubSpot deals (open + recently closed-won) → exact conversion to the base currency → batch update of fx_ properties → audit. DH Robin · dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. Sandbox makes no outside calls; dry run reads rates and deals but writes nothing.

**Stage 1** Execute the trigger with its pinned fictional rates and deals.
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: real rates + staging HubSpot portal, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: fx_ properties are written.

### Rate guards
Stale rates, a day-over-day jump above MAX_DAILY_RATE_CHANGE_PCT or an ECB vs OER disagreement hold that currency: its deals are left untouched and listed in the audit.
